summary: The MCP owner execution (mcp_capability_execute_owner, readOnly false) passes --owner-direct to typed-execute, so the owner's typed claw_execute runs like the owner text path (e.g. WhatsApp messaging.send from the Claude chat). Read-only methods, previews, other callers and other surfaces never carry the flag.
reason: S24 04/11 18:25: a typed WhatsApp send from the Claude chat (profile chat-owner) was refused read_only_policy. Amine 04/11 19:05 (S24 decision 3b693cd2…): no constraint on sending a WhatsApp message at his request from the Claude chat, Samantha voice or elsewhere.

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-typed-capability-tools.cjs
tests.evidence: Extended (already in ci.yml): the owner MCP typed execute carries --owner-direct; a preview, a read-only call, caller other, a missing readOnly and surface whatsapp never do. Built with tsc before running.

capabilities.reason: Same capabilities and routes; the owner MCP typed path executes like the owner text path.

architecture.reason: One host flag on the existing capabilityBridge → claw-capability.py → typed-execute chain.

evidence: claw_execute typed with profile chat-owner reaches typed-execute --owner-direct; chat-owner-shadow writes are still denied before the bridge (mcpBridge.ts selectedRisk check).

limitations: Requires samantha-ui-playbooks PR #397 (typed-execute accepts --owner-direct) activated first: an older playbooks snapshot rejects the unknown flag and the owner typed MCP call would fail.
Policy confirmation risks (transaction, sensitive, destructive) still require a confirmation; payment untouched.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy; typed MCP calls return to read-only.
